text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
My word, the atmosphere at that board game 
cafe... is magnificent. I must visit 
frequently to support their business.

One day, on the way back from playing at 
our usual board game cafe with Rulership—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! You there, the Umamusume 
with the sharp gaze, wanna try your luck?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oops, looks like I couldn't hide my 
surging gamer spirit after all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A lottery, huh... At first glance, it 
seems like pure luck. However—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Actually, I have a sure-fire way to win.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, as for how to do it— Well, let me just 
show you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. Play a card to the 
field, and let the game begin.

I hand over a lottery ticket, and together 
we grip the lever.
The result of the fateful draw was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heh, hehehehe... Ahahaha—!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that, Trainer?! Just as 
planned!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Did I not tell you I had a surefire way to 
win? With my skill, snagging the grand 
prize is child's play.
choice_data_list:
Magnificent! What was your secret 
method...?
Brilliant! How did you do that...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha, my own talent... it terrifies 
me! Now then, off to the hot springs!

"...She didn't tell me. Maybe she wants me 
to... figure it out myself."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Going on a trip means... we get a private 
room to ourselves. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
We could even host a small board game 
convention here. Usually, I just rent a 
room at the community center, though.
choice_data_list:
The inn is deep in the mountains, so a 
convention might be...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hm, I see. Very well. An overnight gaming 
session, even with just two people—is a 
board gamer's dream!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let us continue racking up 
victories until that day arrives— and set 
out with our heads held high.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.text:
And so, showing off a divine draw, 
Rulership splendidly became the master of 
the raffle.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh, this size... is quite something. 
Even the shading on the surface is truly 
powerful...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: It's practically—a fortress of flesh.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I'd like to line up some board game 
pieces.

Yeah, feels like lining up board game 
pieces.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Spinning tops, huh... Right. Trainer, I've 
got a great idea.

And so, I brought the hamburger steaks 
home, cooked them, and served them on a 
plate.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"How's that! I have surrounded the 
hamburger steak with sides. Quite 
reminiscent of a siege, wouldn't you say?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I call it 'The Trials of Carrot Schügel 
Castle.' A supreme dinner—or rather, a 
supreme board-game feast.
choice_data_list: Oh... What an amazing piece of work!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, let's enjoy our food. Now then—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Whoaaa... It's an invasion of giants from 
the skyyy!"

And so, while engaging in a fantasy 
battle, the two of them delicious enjoyed 
their meal.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oho, to think I could acquire such a 
massive bounty.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
So many carrots... Whenever I see this, I 
can't help but think—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I could use this... as a 
spinning top?

It's a board gamer's conditioned reflex. 
When there's a bunch of identical items, 
you can't help but start analyzing.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: What else to consider is—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Stack 'em up, and whoever knocks it down 
loses, got it?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Looks like there might be one different 
bottle in here.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: And besides that—

You could have endless fun just imagining 
it. Before heading back, the two of them 
enjoyed chatting about relatable everyday 
scenarios.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Just one... Are you serious?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, I thought I found the surefire path 
to victoryâ but it didn't work, huh. Oh 
well.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This one rep might just be the crucial key 
to victory or defeat.
choice_data_list: The key to... victory or defeat?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you know how it goes sometimes. When 
you're playing a board game—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
If only I had one more piece of material! 
I could have built the bridge!

It's a familiar sight indeed. You're 
almost always short just one resource you 
need, kicking yourself in frustration.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, a year from now, we might be 
thinking something like this."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It was thanks to this carrot that I 
managed to dominate the Twinkle Series by 
a hair's breadth!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Now that I think about it, that 
probably wasn't the case.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Lame. This is ridiculous. Can't 
someone trade me five daikon radishes for 
this carrot~?

There was no way a convenient negotiating 
partner would just appear. I decided to 
head back quietly.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Fufufu... I see... So that's how 
it is.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I've completely seen through it. 
This game they call the lucky draw, that 
is.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The rules were extremely simple, yet it 
was an ultra-high-level battle of wits. Or 
so I thought, but—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: It's a total game of luck!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, how boring! What is this, even a 
shriveled-up caterpillar could win this???

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sleep time, sleep time... I'm going 
home to sleep...

Rulership muttered under her breath and 
left for home. But a shriveled-up 
caterpillar won't win anything.
